articles.title: Suspicious tree removal and permits linked to Toronto developer
articles.summary: A Toronto developer is facing new accusations of illegal tree removal at a residential property in Etobicoke. Four trees were recently cut down without permits at a property connected to Modcity. The company denies any wrongdoing.

articles.title: Motorcyclist seriously injured in downtown crash
articles.summary: A motorcyclist suffered serious injuries following a collision in the Church-Wellesley neighbourhood on Sunday.

articles.title: Woman previously arrested at anti-Israel protest arrested again during North York demonstration
articles.summary: A 40-year-old woman has been charged after an arrest was made during a demonstration in North York on Sunday.

articles.title: Thousands gather for major Diwali celebration in Brampton
articles.summary: Thousands of people from across the GTA gathered in Brampton on Sunday for the city's annual Diwali Mela, marking the Hindu Festival for the fourth consecutive year.

articles.title: Workers rally against potential layoffs at Etobicoke nursing home
articles.summary: A group of unionized long-term care workers rallied in Etobicoke Saturday to sound the alarm over potential layoffs and staffing shortages.

articles.title: Brampton man charged in multiple street racing incidents across GTA
articles.summary: A 24-year-old Brampton man is facing more than half a dozen charges in connection with multiple street racing incidents across the GTA.

articles.title: York University investigating cybersecurity incident, data theft that dates back almost 20 years
articles.summary: York University is investigating a cybersecurity incident resulting in the theft of personal data which was discovered last month.

articles.title: ‘Godzilla Minus Zero’ stomps to a record-setting $31.6 debut, clobbering ‘The Cat in the Hat’
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — “Godzilla Minus Zero” stomped into movie theaters with a chart-topping $31.6 million over the weekend, scoring a record debut for a foreign-language film at the North American box office.

articles.title: Police identify 18-year-old victim of fatal Etobicoke shooting
articles.summary: Toronto police have identified the victim of a homicide in Etobicoke on Saturday. Malik Abass, 18, of Mississauga, was shot in the area of Rathburn Road and The East Mall, the Toronto Police Service said in a news release Sunday.

articles.title: York University warns of personal data theft in cybersecurity incident
articles.summary: York University is warning the community of a cybersecurity incident that resulted in the theft of personal information, including personal contact details and student identification numbers.

articles.title: Man, 45, accused of breaking into multiple Brampton area vehicles
articles.summary: A rash of vehicle break-ins was recently reported in the city of Brampton and detectives believe they may have found the culprit. On Nov. 3, Peel Regional Police arrested 45-year-old Frank Medeiros of no fixed address in connection with a series of “vehicle-related mischief incidents” and thefts from motor vehicles, according to a press release […]

articles.title: Fire at Vaughan restaurant investigated as possible arson: York police
articles.summary: York police are investigating a suspected case of arson after a fire at Shawarma Royale in Vaughan on Sunday morning.

articles.title: An Ontario nature sanctuary home to over 70 rare species will now be protected for generations to come
articles.summary: A nature sanctuary in Whitby, Ont., home to over 70 rare species, some of which are at-risk, is now part of the Ontario Nature reserve system after its acquisition of the forested area from its previous land trust owners last week.

articles.title: Person dead after shooting in Etobicoke: police
articles.summary: A person has died after a shooting in Etobicoke Saturday, according to Toronto police.

articles.title: A dip in gold prices brings out jewelry shoppers in Mississauga on Diwali weekend
articles.summary: As gold prices dip, some shoppers are taking advantage by buying jewelry during the South Asian festival of Diwali.

articles.title: Scarborough Health Network hosts breast screening awareness event for Black community
articles.summary: Dozens of Black women were screened for breast cancer Saturday at an awareness event hosted by the Scarborough Health Network.

articles.title: Hunter’s brace powers AFC Toronto back to NSL final
articles.summary: Kaylee Hunter scored twice as AFC Toronto booked its place in the 2026 Northern Super League final with a commanding 4-0 victory over Ottawa Rapid FC in the second leg of their semifinal matchup at TD Place in Ottawa.

articles.title: Confirmed measles case in Durham region: unimmunized child with history of recent international travel
articles.summary: Durham region’s health department is warning residents of a confirmed measles case in an unimmunized child with a history of recent international travel.

articles.title: Problematic or protected? The debate over filming police in real time
articles.summary: Social media posts showing real-time positions of police officers in a standoff with an armed suspect at the University of Toronto's Mississauga campus on Monday night prompted a stern warning from police, but legal experts say the law isn't clear-cut on the issue.
